Requirement: User should be capable of performing every aspect in the normative GSN v3 standard with OntoGSN.
OntoGSN should represent knowledge about GSN assurance cases in direct conformity with the standard metamodel.
OntoGSN should be aligned with the ASCE XML schema.
The user should be able to use OntoGSN as a standalone framework.
The user should be able to use OntoGSN in an accessible manner.
OntoGSN should not duplicate the features provided by existing tools and frameworks (e.g., GUI, imports/exports).
The user should have an accessible and easy way to create SPARQL queries based on a case ABox conformant to the OntoGSN TBox.
